content:
mara: Heads-up — scheduling a short maintenance slot tomorrow 01:00 UTC to land a schema change on users.auth_providers. Adds provider_metadata JSONB and a nullable flag. Backfill job will stream but we expect a quick exclusive lock for the DDL (~5-10s). Planning window 01:00-01:20 UTC. Pin deploy tag to v2.14.3-dbfix :spiral_calendar: 

deploy-bot: Deploy created by @mara for service user-api. Tag=v2.14.3-dbfix. Migration job attached: migrations/2026_03_add_provider_metadata.sql. Scheduled: 2245102800 (01:00 UTC). Canary nodes: 2.

josh: ping on lock surface — what's the plan if replicas lag? can we do a replica-first check and abort? :warning:

tina: +1 on abort condition. Proposed preflight: ensure replica lag < 30s for 5m, and no active long transactions touching auth_providers. If lag > 30s, pause and reschedule slot.

luca: migration SQL is small, but backfill might scan indexes. We should throttle the backfill with our row-limiter and run in batches of 10k. Add a kill-switch to stop the backfill job on high CPU.

sre-ops: We’ll add a traffic-split to route 10% traffic to canary during the window, with automatic rollback on 5xx spike > 2m. Also add a DB connection cap for the job role.

mara: Updated runbook snapshot in the deploy: steps + rollback. Key ops: (1) pin API release to v2.14.3-dbfix, (2) run preflight script, (3) apply DDL during quiet window, (4) start backfill with limiter, (5) monitor replication + latencies for 20m.

josh: Can we include an explicit escape hatch command sequence? Save us time if we need to bail.

mara: Yes — included in runbook. Quick summary here:

```
# escape hatch (fast rollback)
# 1) stop backfill: systemctl stop provider-backfill || kill <pid>
# 2) restore read traffic: trafficctl set-weight user-api 100
# 3) apply rollback migration (schema-safe): psql -c "ALTER TABLE users.auth_providers DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS provider_metadata;"
# 4) roll service to previous tag: deployctl rollback user-api --tag v2.14.2
# 5) restore backups if needed: s3cmd cp s3://db-backups/pre-migration-20260320.sql.gz /tmp && pg_restore ...
```

Note: DROP COLUMN is fast here because it's nullable and empty for almost all rows, but we keep backups just in case.

luca: add a health-check for the auth endpoints before and after the DDL. If 99p latency > 500ms for 3m, trigger rollback.

tina: I'll own preflight checks at T-15m and watch replication. Mara, can you pin the deploy tag in the release notes and call out the backfill limiter values?

mara: Done — release notes updated and tag pinned. Backfill batch=10k, sleep_ms=200 between batches, max_concurrency=4.

sre-ops: Canary started at 01:00 UTC => deploy-bot will post status. If canary passes 10m, we continue to full. If not, we'll invoke escape hatch.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment progress: 2/2 canaries healthy. No 5xxs. Monitoring window started.

josh: thanks — standing by for T-15 and smoke. :white_check_mark:

mara: After the window we'll run a light verification sweep and then mark the release. If any unexpected locks appear, escalate to dbops and hit rollback asap.

sre-ops: Noted. All runbook links and on-call pages are attached to the deploy.

luca: FYI I'll have a quick follow-up job to compact indexes next week — won't affect this slot.

mara: Great. See you all tomorrow 01:00 UTC.
